obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the loan-to-value ratio of a housing loan within 85 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eluasemelaenu andmise piirmäärad ja maksimaalne laenutähtaeg (Eesti Panga presidendi 12.12.2014 määrus nr 17, RT I, 16.12.2014, 17), § 1 lg 1¹ ja 2, § 3 lg 2, 3 ja 8, consolidated text RT I, 13.06.2025, 28, in force from 16.06.2025

titles.en: Keep the loan-to-value ratio of a housing loan within 85 per cent

summaries.en: A credit institution operating in Estonia, including the Estonian branch of a foreign one, may lend to a natural person for buying, building, extending, reconstructing or renovating a dwelling in Estonia only up to 85 per cent of the value of the mortgaged property, or 90 per cent where the loan is state-guaranteed. The ratio must be met at the moment the loan, or its first instalment, is placed at the borrower's disposal. A loan that restructures or refinances an earlier loan without exceeding the claim under it is outside the limit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Secure housing loans with a first-ranking mortgage valued at the lower of appraisal and price
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eluasemelaenu andmise piirmäärad ja maksimaalne laenutähtaeg (Eesti Panga presidendi 12.12.2014 määrus nr 17, RT I, 16.12.2014, 17), § 3 lg 4–7, consolidated text RT I, 13.06.2025, 28, in force from 16.06.2025

titles.en: Secure housing loans with a first-ranking mortgage valued at the lower of appraisal and price

summaries.en: The housing loan is secured by a mortgage in favour of the lending institution on the dwelling financed or on other property of the borrower, a co-applicant or a third party, and only first-ranking mortgages count unless every earlier rank is held by the same institution or the state. For the loan-to-value ratio the property is valued at the lower of its market value appraised before the contract and the actual purchase price. Where the same collateral also secures other loans, all the loans it secures are added together.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the borrower's loan payments within 50 per cent of net income, at a stressed rate of at least 6 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eluasemelaenu andmise piirmäärad ja maksimaalne laenutähtaeg (Eesti Panga presidendi 12.12.2014 määrus nr 17, RT I, 16.12.2014, 17), § 4 lg 1–5 ja 7, consolidated text RT I, 13.06.2025, 28, in force from 16.06.2025

titles.en: Keep the borrower's loan payments within 50 per cent of net income, at a stressed rate of at least 6 per cent

summaries.en: The monthly principal and interest payments on all of the borrower's consumer credit known to the lending institution, the new housing loan included, may not exceed 50 per cent of the borrower's regular, documented after-tax income; for a joint application the payments and incomes of borrower and co-applicant are added together. For a housing loan with a floating rate the payment is calculated at the contract rate or an annual 6 per cent, whichever is higher.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Limit the contractual term of a housing loan to 30 years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eluasemelaenu andmise piirmäärad ja maksimaalne laenutähtaeg (Eesti Panga presidendi 12.12.2014 määrus nr 17, RT I, 16.12.2014, 17), § 5, consolidated text RT I, 13.06.2025, 28, in force from 16.06.2025

titles.en: Limit the contractual term of a housing loan to 30 years

summaries.en: The contractual repayment term of a housing loan may be at most 30 years, counted from the first day of the third calendar month after the month in which the loan amount, or its first instalment, is placed at the borrower's disposal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Grant housing loans outside the limits for at most 15 per cent of a quarter's new lending
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eluasemelaenu andmise piirmäärad ja maksimaalne laenutähtaeg (Eesti Panga presidendi 12.12.2014 määrus nr 17, RT I, 16.12.2014, 17), § 6, consolidated text RT I, 13.06.2025, 28, in force from 16.06.2025

titles.en: Grant housing loans outside the limits for at most 15 per cent of a quarter's new lending

summaries.en: A credit institution may grant housing loans that exceed the loan-to-value or the payment-to-income limit, or run longer than the maximum term, only up to 15 per cent of the total amount of new housing loans it grants during the quarter.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the institution-specific countercyclical buffer rate as an exposure-weighted average
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vastutsüklilise kapitalipuhvri määra arvutamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 01.12.2015 määrus nr 9, RT I, 02.12.2015, 15), § 2 ja § 3 lg 1–4, consolidated text RT I, 09.06.2021, 4, in force from 12.06.2021

titles.en: Calculate the institution-specific countercyclical buffer rate as an exposure-weighted average

summaries.en: A credit institution licensed in Estonia calculates, individually and on a consolidated basis, its institution-specific countercyclical buffer rate as the weighted average of the rates that apply where its relevant credit exposures are located. Each location is weighted by its share of the credit-risk own funds requirements under Part Three, Titles II and IV of the Capital Requirements Regulation in the total for all relevant credit exposures. Relevant exposures are the Article 112 classes other than those in points a to f, and their location is determined under Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1152/2014.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply the higher of Eesti Pank's and the ECB's rate to Estonian exposures from the date set
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vastutsüklilise kapitalipuhvri määra arvutamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 01.12.2015 määrus nr 9, RT I, 02.12.2015, 15), § 3 lg 5 ja 6, consolidated text RT I, 09.06.2021, 4, in force from 12.06.2021

titles.en: Apply the higher of Eesti Pank's and the ECB's rate to Estonian exposures from the date set

summaries.en: For relevant credit exposures located in Estonia the institution applies the countercyclical buffer rate set by Eesti Pank or the one set by the European Central Bank under Article 5(2) of Regulation (EU) No 1024/2013, whichever is higher. It takes each rate into account from the effective date that Eesti Pank or the designated authority of the other country has set for it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply other countries' buffer rates up to 2.5 per cent, and 0 per cent where a third country has set none
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vastutsüklilise kapitalipuhvri määra arvutamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 01.12.2015 määrus nr 9, RT I, 02.12.2015, 15), § 4 ja § 5, consolidated text RT I, 09.06.2021, 4, in force from 12.06.2021

titles.en: Apply other countries' buffer rates up to 2.5 per cent, and 0 per cent where a third country has set none

summaries.en: For exposures in another EEA state the institution applies the rate set there up to 2.5 per cent, and 2.5 per cent where the rate set there is higher, unless Eesti Pank has set and published the same rate for that state. For exposures in a third country it applies the rate set there up to 2.5 per cent unless Eesti Pank has set and published a higher one, 2.5 per cent where the third country's rate is higher unless Eesti Pank has set and published a rate, and 0 per cent where the third country has set no rate and Eesti Pank has set and published none.

obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vastutsüklilise kapitalipuhvri määra kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 28.11.2022 määrus nr 11, RT I, 01.12.2022, 1), § 1 ja 3, original text RT I, 01.12.2022, 1, in force from 01.12.2023

titles.en: Apply a countercyclical buffer rate of 1.5 per cent to credit exposures located in Estonia

summaries.en: The countercyclical capital buffer rate that credit institutions apply to their credit exposures located in Estonia is 1.5 per cent, in force since 1 December 2023. Under Eesti Pank's regulation on calculating the institution-specific rate, a credit institution uses it for its Estonian exposures unless the ECB has set a higher one.

summaries.en: Every credit institution licensed in Estonia applies a systemic risk buffer rate of 2 per cent, when it calculates its systemic risk buffer, to its retail exposures to natural persons resident in Lithuania that are secured by residential property. This requirement applies on top of any other systemic risk buffer requirement in force in Estonia.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold the other systemically important institution buffer at the rate set for the bank
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Muu süsteemselt olulise krediidiasutuse puhver (Eesti Panga presidendi 30.05.2016 määrus nr 7, RT I, 01.06.2016, 4), § 1–3, consolidated text RT I, 06.12.2024, 11, in force from 01.01.2025

titles.en: Hold the other systemically important institution buffer at the rate set for the bank

summaries.en: The regulation names Swedbank AS, AS SEB Pank, AS LHV Pank, Luminor Bank AS, Coop Pank AS and Bigbank AS as other systemically important credit institutions in Estonia. Each must hold the buffer at 2 per cent (Swedbank, SEB Pank, LHV Pank and Luminor) or 0.5 per cent (Coop Pank and Bigbank) of its total risk exposure amount calculated under Article 92(3) of the Capital Requirements Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the buffer individually and at the highest Estonian level of consolidation
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Muu süsteemselt olulise krediidiasutuse puhver (Eesti Panga presidendi 30.05.2016 määrus nr 7, RT I, 01.06.2016, 4), § 4, consolidated text RT I, 06.12.2024, 11, in force from 01.01.2025

titles.en: Meet the buffer individually and at the highest Estonian level of consolidation

summaries.en: A bank named in the regulation must meet its other systemically important institution buffer requirement both individually and on a consolidated basis. Where it belongs to a consolidation group, the consolidated requirement is met at that group's highest level of consolidation in Estonia.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the minimum reserve calculation to Eesti Pank by the 17th bank day after each reporting period
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuse kohustusliku reservi nõude arvestuse aruande kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 07.12.2010 määrus nr 22, RT I, 15.12.2010, 6), § 2 ja § 4 lg 1–5, consolidated text RT I, 27.06.2026, 2, in force from 01.07.2026

titles.en: Report the minimum reserve calculation to Eesti Pank by the 17th bank day after each reporting period

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia, including the branches of foreign credit institutions but not the foreign branches of Estonian ones, draws up the minimum reserve requirement calculation report (code 55) on the annexed template and submits it to Eesti Pank for each monthly period in the calendar Eesti Pank publishes, by the 17th bank day of the following month. The report is in whole euros, uses the definitions of the supplementary balance sheet reporting regulation and goes to Eesti Pank as XML under the regulation on electronic submission of reports.

titles.en: Resubmit a corrected minimum reserve report on finding an error and file an empty one when there is no data

summaries.en: When an error is found in a minimum reserve report the credit institution submits a new, corrected report. Where it has no data within the report's scope it still submits the report, empty.

titles.en: Where the bank has branches abroad, report the Estonian head office's data separately

summaries.en: A credit institution with branches outside Estonia also submits to Eesti Pank a balance sheet report covering only its unit located in Estonia (the head office), and shows only the head office's data in its income statement report.

summaries.en: A credit institution with branches outside Estonia also submits to Eesti Pank the resources, loans and securities reports covering only its unit located in Estonia, and shows only the head office's data in the housing loans report and in all reports to Eesti Pank.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report in euros to two decimals in XML with the standard codes, and resubmit on errors
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuse bilansi täiendava aruandluse kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 13.05.2025 määrus nr 3, RT I, 27.05.2025, 2), § 3 lg 4–7, § 5 ja § 6, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 2, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Report in euros to two decimals in XML with the standard codes, and resubmit on errors

summaries.en: The reports are in euros rounded to two decimals, with rates as decimals of the stated precision and foreign currency converted at the ECB rate of the period's last bank day, using ISO 4217, ISO 3166-1, EMTAK and ISO 8601 codes. They go in XML under the regulation on electronic submission of reports; new corrected reports follow when errors are found or accounting policies change, and an empty report is filed when there is no data.

instruments.title: Add Järelevalvealase finantsteabe aruandlus, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on individual-basis supervisory financial reporting (Eesti Panga presidendi 05.02.2016 määrus nr 3)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded järelevalvealase finantsteabe aruandluse esitamisele individuaalsel alusel (Eesti Panga presidendi 05.02.2016 määrus nr 3), RT I, 09.02.2016, 19, consolidated text RT I, 19.06.2018, 6, in force from 01.07.2018, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Krediidiasutuste seadus § 91 lg 1, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Nõuded järelevalvealase finantsteabe aruandluse esitamisele individuaalsel alusel
titles.en: Requirements for submitting supervisory financial reporting on an individual basis

payload.officialRef: Nõuded järelevalvealase finantsteabe aruandluse esitamisele individuaalsel alusel (RT I, 09.02.2016, 19)
payload.implementsNote: Applies ECB Regulation (EU) 2015/534 on reporting of supervisory financial information, whose Annex I the reports follow (§ 3 of the regulation)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit simplified supervisory financial reports to Finantsinspektsioon by the last bank day of the month after each reference date
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded järelevalvealase finantsteabe aruandluse esitamisele individuaalsel alusel (Eesti Panga presidendi 05.02.2016 määrus nr 3, RT I, 09.02.2016, 19), § 2, § 3, § 3¹ ja § 4, consolidated text RT I, 19.06.2018, 6, in force from 01.07.2018

titles.en: Submit simplified supervisory financial reports to Finantsinspektsioon by the last bank day of the month after each reference date

summaries.en: Every credit institution established in Estonia and every Estonian branch of a foreign credit institution submits to Finantsinspektsioon, on an individual basis, the simplified supervisory financial information reports of Annex I to ECB Regulation (EU) 2015/534, following that annex's instructions. Quarterly reports are as of 31 March, 30 June, 30 September and 31 December and the annual one as of 31 December, each by the last bank day of the month after the reference date, with period data cumulative from the start of the year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the reports in XBRL with ISO codes and the set precision
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded järelevalvealase finantsteabe aruandluse esitamisele individuaalsel alusel (Eesti Panga presidendi 05.02.2016 määrus nr 3, RT I, 09.02.2016, 19), § 5–8, consolidated text RT I, 19.06.2018, 6, in force from 01.07.2018

titles.en: File the reports in XBRL with ISO codes and the set precision

summaries.en: The reports go to Finantsinspektsioon electronically in XBRL, following the regulation and the requirements on Finantsinspektsioon's website, and are sent to the address the regulation names. Currency and country codes follow ISO 4217 and ISO 3166 in capitals, amounts are in whole euros or to the cent, and percentages are decimals rounded to four places.

instruments.title: Add Detailsete krediidiandmete aruanded, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on granular credit data reports (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.03.2017 määrus nr 6)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.03.2017 määrus nr 6), RT I, 31.03.2017, 6, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 8, in force from 02.03.2026, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Krediidiasutuste seadus § 91 lg 1 ja 3, Riikliku statistika seadus § 30¹ lg 3¹, Article 5 of the ESCB Statute and Article 4 of Regulation (EC) No 2533/98, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 6 lg 1 of the regulation

titles.et: Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded
titles.en: Requirements for submitting granular credit data reports

payload.officialRef: Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded (RT I, 31.03.2017, 6)
payload.implementsNote: Applies ECB Regulation (EU) 2016/867 on the collection of granular credit and credit risk data, as § 1 of the regulation states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report granular credit data to Eesti Pank without the reporting threshold
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.03.2017 määrus nr 6, RT I, 31.03.2017, 6), § 2 ja § 3 lg 1–4, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 8, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Report granular credit data to Eesti Pank without the reporting threshold

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia, branches of foreign ones included, draws up the eleven credit data reports the regulation lists (counterparty, instrument, financial, joint liabilities, counterparty role, accounting, protection, instrument-protection, counterparty risk and counterparty default data) under Article 4(1) of ECB Regulation (EU) 2016/867 and submits them to Eesti Pank. The reporting threshold of Article 5 of that regulation does not apply, so every instrument is reported; Eesti Pank may release a small institution from the duty and tells it so.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include the credit data of the bank's branches in other member states
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.03.2017 määrus nr 6, RT I, 31.03.2017, 6), § 3 lg 6, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 8, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Include the credit data of the bank's branches in other member states

summaries.en: A credit institution with branches outside Estonia reports the credit data both of its unit in Estonia and of its branches in the reporting member states, unless Eesti Pank has told it that it waives some or all of the counterparty and instrument reports for those branches.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the monthly credit data reports by the 15th or 17th bank day and the quarterly ones by the 35th
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.03.2017 määrus nr 6, RT I, 31.03.2017, 6), § 4, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 8, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Submit the monthly credit data reports by the 15th or 17th bank day and the quarterly ones by the 35th

summaries.en: The counterparty reports for residents and non-residents are monthly and due by the 15th bank day after the month; the instrument, financial, joint liabilities, counterparty role, protection, instrument-protection and default reports are monthly and due by the 17th bank day; the accounting and counterparty risk reports are quarterly and due by the 35th bank day after the quarter.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the reports in XML, resubmit them on errors and keep the barred characters out
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Detailsete krediidiandmete aruannete esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.03.2017 määrus nr 6, RT I, 31.03.2017, 6), § 5, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 8, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Submit the reports in XML, resubmit them on errors and keep the barred characters out

summaries.en: The reports go to Eesti Pank as XML under the regulation on electronic submission of reports, and new corrected reports follow when errors are found or accounting policies change. Text and attributes in the reports may not contain the characters the regulation lists (angle brackets, ampersand and quotation marks).

instruments.title: Add Krediidiasutuste maksestatistiline aruandlus, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on payment statistics reporting (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.06.2021 määrus nr 11)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.06.2021 määrus nr 11), RT I, 18.06.2021, 23, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 9, in force from 02.03.2026, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Krediidiasutuste seadus § 91 lg 1 ja 3, Riikliku statistika seadus § 30¹ lg 3¹, Article 5 of the ESCB Statute and Article 4 of Regulation (EC) No 2533/98, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 19 of the regulation

titles.et: Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine
titles.en: Payment statistics reporting of credit institutions

payload.officialRef: Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine (RT I, 18.06.2021, 23)
payload.implementsNote: Serves ECB Regulation (EU) No 1409/2013 on payments statistics (ECB/2013/43), as § 1 lg 2 of the regulation states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report payments and card transactions to Eesti Pank every month by the seventh bank day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.06.2021 määrus nr 11, RT I, 18.06.2021, 23), § 2, § 3 p 1 ja 2 ja § 4, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 9, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Report payments and card transactions to Eesti Pank every month by the seventh bank day

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia, branches included, reports on the activity of its unit in Estonia the payments report (code 160) and the card transactions report (code 161) to Eesti Pank for each month, by the seventh bank day after the month ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report cards, terminals and the regional split of cash transactions every quarter by the seventh bank day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.06.2021 määrus nr 11, RT I, 18.06.2021, 23), § 3 p 3, 4 ja 8 ja § 4, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 9, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Report cards, terminals and the regional split of cash transactions every quarter by the seventh bank day

summaries.en: The credit institution reports the payment cards report (code 162), the report on ATMs, points of sale and terminals (code 163) and the report on the regional distribution of cash transactions (code 168) for each quarter, by the seventh bank day after the quarter ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report card, payment and e-money fraud every half year within three months
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.06.2021 määrus nr 11, RT I, 18.06.2021, 23), § 3 p 5–7 ja § 4, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 9, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Report card, payment and e-money fraud every half year within three months

summaries.en: The credit institution reports fraud related to card transactions (code 165), fraud related to payments (code 166) and e-money payment transactions with related fraud (code 167) for each half year, within three months after it ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the payment statistics in XML with the standard codes, correct errors and file empty reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutuste maksestatistilise aruandluse kehtestamine (Eesti Panga presidendi 15.06.2021 määrus nr 11, RT I, 18.06.2021, 23), § 5 ja § 6, consolidated text RT I, 27.02.2026, 9, in force from 02.03.2026

titles.en: Submit the payment statistics in XML with the standard codes, correct errors and file empty reports

summaries.en: The reports go to Eesti Pank as XML under the regulation on electronic submission of reports, a corrected report follows whenever an error is found, and an empty report is filed when there is no data. Currency and country codes follow ISO 4217 and ISO 3166-1 in capitals, the payee's activity follows the fourth level of EMTAK and the merchant category follows ISO 18245.

instruments.title: Add Aruannete elektrooniline esitamine, the Governor of Eesti Pank's regulation on the electronic submission of reports (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.05.2018 määrus nr 4)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aruannete elektroonilise esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.05.2018 määrus nr 4), RT I, 05.06.2018, 1, original text RT I, 05.06.2018, 1, in force from 01.01.2019, issued by the Governor of Eesti Pank under Krediidiasutuste seadus § 91 lg 1, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 12 of the regulation

titles.et: Aruannete elektroonilise esitamise nõuded
titles.en: Requirements for the electronic submission of reports

payload.officialRef: Aruannete elektroonilise esitamise nõuded (RT I, 05.06.2018, 1)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit reports to Eesti Pank and Finantsinspektsioon through the joint data collection portal in XML or XBRL
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aruannete elektroonilise esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.05.2018 määrus nr 4, RT I, 05.06.2018, 1), § 2, § 4 lg 1 ja 2, § 5 lg 1–4 ja § 10, original text RT I, 05.06.2018, 1, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Submit reports to Eesti Pank and Finantsinspektsioon through the joint data collection portal in XML or XBRL

summaries.en: A credit institution or branch that reports to Eesti Pank or Finantsinspektsioon submits its reports through the joint data collection portal, by entering data, loading a file, uploading a report file or sending it by e-mail or web service. A report sent as a file is formatted in XML against the published schemas or in XBRL under the EBA's requirements, and it counts as submitted only when it is correct in content and made as the regulation requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Encrypt and sign report messages sent over open channels and manage the keys and certificates
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aruannete elektroonilise esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.05.2018 määrus nr 4, RT I, 05.06.2018, 1), § 4 lg 3 ja § 6 lg 1–4, original text RT I, 05.06.2018, 1, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Encrypt and sign report messages sent over open channels and manage the keys and certificates

summaries.en: A report message sent by e-mail is encrypted and digitally signed, and one sent over a secured channel such as HTTPS is at least digitally signed, using OpenPGP, DigiDoc or an X.509 certificate. The reporting entity is responsible for managing the keys and certificates it needs, which it does in the portal.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage the portal's users, their rights and contact details
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Aruannete elektroonilise esitamise nõuded (Eesti Panga presidendi 29.05.2018 määrus nr 4, RT I, 05.06.2018, 1), § 7, original text RT I, 05.06.2018, 1, in force from 01.01.2019

titles.en: Manage the portal's users, their rights and contact details

summaries.en: The reporting entity is responsible for administering its users of the data collection portal, including authorising them, assigning their rights, keeping their contact details up to date and ending their authorisations, and does so in the portal.

instruments.title: Add Aruandekohustus Rahapesu Andmebüroole, the Minister of Finance's regulation on reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit (Rahandusministri 12.09.2023 määrus nr 34)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutustele ja virtuaalvääringu teenuse pakkujatele aruandekohustuse kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 12.09.2023 määrus nr 34), RT I, 15.09.2023, 3, consolidated text RT I, 13.12.2023, 16, in force from 16.12.2023, issued by the Minister of Finance under Rahapesu ja terrorismi rahastamise tõkestamise seadus § 54¹ lg 3 and Riikliku statistika seadus § 30¹ lg 3, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Krediidiasutustele ja virtuaalvääringu teenuse pakkujatele aruandekohustuse kehtestamine
titles.en: Reporting obligation of credit institutions and virtual currency service providers

payload.officialRef: Krediidiasutustele ja virtuaalvääringu teenuse pakkujatele aruandekohustuse kehtestamine (RT I, 15.09.2023, 3)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the Financial Intelligence Unit the Eesti Pank reports the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutustele ja virtuaalvääringu teenuse pakkujatele aruandekohustuse kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 12.09.2023 määrus nr 34, RT I, 15.09.2023, 3), § 2, § 4 lg 1 ja § 5 lg 1, consolidated text RT I, 13.12.2023, 16, in force from 16.12.2023

titles.en: Send the Financial Intelligence Unit the Eesti Pank reports the regulation lists

summaries.en: A credit institution operating in Estonia, branches included, submits to the Financial Intelligence Unit the annexes of six Eesti Pank regulations the regulation lists: on credit institutions' balance of payments reporting, supplementary balance sheet reporting, off-balance-sheet reporting, balance of payments data, payment statistics and granular credit data. It does so for the periods, by the deadlines and in the way those Eesti Pank regulations set for each report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a virtual currency service provider, report quarterly to Eesti Pank and the Financial Intelligence Unit within 20 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutustele ja virtuaalvääringu teenuse pakkujatele aruandekohustuse kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 12.09.2023 määrus nr 34, RT I, 15.09.2023, 3), § 3, § 4 lg 2 ja 3 ja § 5 lg 2, consolidated text RT I, 13.12.2023, 16, in force from 16.12.2023

titles.en: As a virtual currency service provider, report quarterly to Eesti Pank and the Financial Intelligence Unit within 20 days

summaries.en: A virtual currency service provider operating in Estonia draws up the six reports in the regulation's annexes (general activity data, due diligence measures, services provided, clients' assets, balance sheet and income statement, codes 980 to 985) and submits them to Eesti Pank and the Financial Intelligence Unit through Eesti Pank's reporting environment. The period is a quarter unless an annex says otherwise, the reports are due within 20 days after it ends, and the balance sheet and income statement follow the Accounting Act with the regulation's specific rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File an empty report when there is no data and a corrected one without delay on finding a deficiency
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiasutustele ja virtuaalvääringu teenuse pakkujatele aruandekohustuse kehtestamine (Rahandusministri 12.09.2023 määrus nr 34, RT I, 15.09.2023, 3), § 5 lg 3 ja 4, consolidated text RT I, 13.12.2023, 16, in force from 16.12.2023

titles.en: File an empty report when there is no data and a corrected one without delay on finding a deficiency

summaries.en: Where there is no data within a report's scope the filer still submits the report, empty. When a deficiency is found in a report, a new corrected report is submitted without delay.

instruments.title: Add Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatav teade, the Minister of Finance's regulation on the form of reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit (Rahandusministri 20.11.2020 määrus nr 42)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatava teate sisu ja vorm ning teate esitamise juhend (Rahandusministri 20.11.2020 määrus nr 42), RT I, 24.11.2020, 8, original text RT I, 24.11.2020, 8, in force from 01.01.2021, issued by the Minister of Finance under Rahapesu ja terrorismi rahastamise tõkestamise seadus § 50 lg 4 and Rahvusvahelise sanktsiooni seadus § 21 lg 5, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 2 of the regulation

titles.et: Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatava teate sisu ja vorm ning teate esitamise juhend
titles.en: Content and form of reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit and instructions for filing them

payload.officialRef: Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatava teate sisu ja vorm ning teate esitamise juhend (RT I, 24.11.2020, 8)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit digitally on its online form or in the agreed XML format
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatava teate sisu ja vorm ning teate esitamise juhend (Rahandusministri 20.11.2020 määrus nr 42, RT I, 24.11.2020, 8), § 1 ja lisa 2 p 8 ja 9, original text RT I, 24.11.2020, 8, in force from 01.01.2021, annex 2 as the gazette publishes it with the text (RM_m42_lisa2.pdf)

titles.en: File reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit digitally on its online form or in the agreed XML format

summaries.en: A person obliged under the anti-money laundering act or the international sanctions act files its report to the Financial Intelligence Unit digitally, either on the form on the Unit's website or in the XML format agreed with the Unit through the X-tee data exchange layer. Only exceptionally, where neither is possible and the Unit allows it, may a report be sent by e-mail.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Fill in every mandatory field and give an e-mailed report at least the minimum content
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatava teate sisu ja vorm ning teate esitamise juhend (Rahandusministri 20.11.2020 määrus nr 42, RT I, 24.11.2020, 8), lisa 2 p 10 ja 12, original text RT I, 24.11.2020, 8, in force from 01.01.2021, annex 2 as the gazette publishes it with the text (RM_m42_lisa2.pdf)

titles.en: Fill in every mandatory field and give an e-mailed report at least the minimum content

summaries.en: On the online form every field marked with an asterisk must be completed and the others filled in where the information exists. A report sent by e-mail contains at least the drafter's and the reporter's identification and contact data, the report type and number, the main reason for reporting and any further ones, the identification, roles and location of everyone involved in the transaction, data on its object and a description of it, with copies of relevant documents where needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the Financial Intelligence Unit when applying an EU financial sanction tied to a territory, entity or goods
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatava teate sisu ja vorm ning teate esitamise juhend (Rahandusministri 20.11.2020 määrus nr 42, RT I, 24.11.2020, 8), lisa 2 p 6, original text RT I, 24.11.2020, 8, in force from 01.01.2021, annex 2 as the gazette publishes it with the text (RM_m42_lisa2.pdf)

titles.en: Notify the Financial Intelligence Unit when applying an EU financial sanction tied to a territory, entity or goods

summaries.en: Where a directly applicable EU regulation imposes a financial sanction tied not to persons but to a territory, an entity or goods, the obliged person notifies the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay of applying it, or of a suspicion that it needs to be applied, and of the measures taken. For a ban or restriction on transporting goods, whose competent authority is the Ministry of Finance (the Tax and Customs Board), the Unit is notified only where the restriction falls within financial sanctions, such as a ban on financing the transaction.

instruments.title: Add Erikohustusega isikute aruanded, the Minister of Finance's regulation on financial sanctions reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit (Rahandusministri 28.03.2025 määrus nr 14)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Erikohustusega isikute Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatavate aruannete andmete täpsem koosseis, esitajad ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 28.03.2025 määrus nr 14), RT I, 02.04.2025, 7, original text RT I, 02.04.2025, 7, in force from 05.04.2025, issued by the Minister of Finance under Rahvusvahelise sanktsiooni seadus § 32¹ lg 3, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Erikohustusega isikute Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatavate aruannete andmete täpsem koosseis, esitajad ja esitamise kord
titles.en: Data content, filers and procedure of the reports that persons with special obligations submit to the Financial Intelligence Unit

payload.officialRef: Erikohustusega isikute Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatavate aruannete andmete täpsem koosseis, esitajad ja esitamise kord (RT I, 02.04.2025, 7)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each quarter the movements on accounts frozen under international financial sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Erikohustusega isikute Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatavate aruannete andmete täpsem koosseis, esitajad ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 28.03.2025 määrus nr 14, RT I, 02.04.2025, 7), § 2 lg 1 ja 3, original text RT I, 02.04.2025, 7, in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: Report each quarter the movements on accounts frozen under international financial sanctions

summaries.en: A credit institution, like a virtual currency service provider, reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit for every completed quarter, on the form in annex 1, the movements of funds on accounts frozen as a result of applying an international financial sanction. The report goes in machine-readable form, encrypted, to the Unit's e-mail address by the 15th day of the month after the quarter, or the next working day if that day is not one.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each quarter the frozen funds held that the account movements report does not show
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Erikohustusega isikute Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatavate aruannete andmete täpsem koosseis, esitajad ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 28.03.2025 määrus nr 14, RT I, 02.04.2025, 7), § 2 lg 2 ja 3, original text RT I, 02.04.2025, 7, in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: Report each quarter the frozen funds held that the account movements report does not show

summaries.en: At the start of each quarter the credit institution reports, as at the end of the completed quarter and on the form in annex 2, the funds frozen as a result of applying an international financial sanction that it holds and that the account movements report does not show, by the same deadline and in the same way.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the frozen funds reports whenever frozen funds are held, also if nothing changed
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Erikohustusega isikute Rahapesu Andmebüroole esitatavate aruannete andmete täpsem koosseis, esitajad ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 28.03.2025 määrus nr 14, RT I, 02.04.2025, 7), § 2 lg 4 ja 5, original text RT I, 02.04.2025, 7, in force from 05.04.2025

titles.en: File the frozen funds reports whenever frozen funds are held, also if nothing changed

summaries.en: The two quarterly reports are filed whenever the credit institution holds frozen funds, even if their data did not change during the quarter. Where it held no frozen funds during the quarter, it files no report.

instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiostja kohta Finantsinspektsioonile esitatava teabe kord ja vormid (Rahandusministri 14.02.2025 määrus nr 12), RT I, 19.02.2025, 9, original text RT I, 19.02.2025, 9, in force from 22.02.2025, issued by the Minister of Finance under Krediidiasutuste seadus § 92³ lg 5, Krediidiandjate ja -vahendajate seadus § 57¹ lg 5 and Krediidiinkassode ja -ostjate seadus § 64 lg 6, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the credit purchaser and every non-performing credit agreement assigned to it
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiostja kohta Finantsinspektsioonile esitatava teabe kord ja vormid (Rahandusministri 14.02.2025 määrus nr 12, RT I, 19.02.2025, 9), § 2–5, original text RT I, 19.02.2025, 9, in force from 22.02.2025

titles.en: Report the credit purchaser and every non-performing credit agreement assigned to it

summaries.en: A credit institution, creditor or credit purchaser operating in Estonia, or its designated representative, draws up and submits to Finantsinspektsioon the report on the credit purchaser or its representative (code 3604) and the report on assigned credit agreements (code 3605), following the forms and instructions in the annexes. The second report covers every credit agreement in default, or claim under one, assigned to a credit purchaser during the period, in the official currency of Estonia to two decimals, with foreign currency converted at the ECB rate of the period's last working day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the reports through the data collection portal in XML and correct deficiencies without undue delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Krediidiostja kohta Finantsinspektsioonile esitatava teabe kord ja vormid (Rahandusministri 14.02.2025 määrus nr 12, RT I, 19.02.2025, 9), § 6 lg 1–4 ja § 7 lg 1, original text RT I, 19.02.2025, 9, in force from 22.02.2025

titles.en: Submit the reports through the data collection portal in XML and correct deficiencies without undue delay

summaries.en: The reports go to Finantsinspektsioon through the data collection portal of Eesti Pank and Finantsinspektsioon, as XML following Finantsinspektsioon's technical and data security requirements. An empty report is filed when there is no data, and a corrected report follows without undue delay when the filer finds a deficiency; banks and creditors apply the regulation from periods ending on 30 June 2025.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report eligible deposits to Finantsinspektsioon every quarter by the tenth bank day of the following month
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Hoiuste tagamise osafondi aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 27.02.2016 määrus nr 14, RT I, 01.03.2016, 10), § 2 lg 1, § 3, § 4 lg 1–3, § 5 lg 1 ja § 6 lg 3, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 20, in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Report eligible deposits to Finantsinspektsioon every quarter by the tenth bank day of the following month

summaries.en: Every credit institution operating in Estonia, and each branch whose home deposit guarantee scheme covers deposits less than the Guarantee Fund Act does, draws up the Guarantee Fund eligible deposits report (code 236) as at the end of each quarter and submits it to Finantsinspektsioon in XML by the tenth bank day of the month after the quarter. Finantsinspektsioon passes the data to the Guarantee Fund; the wording in force since 1 October 2026 applies first to the period ending on 31 December 2026.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Remedy deficiencies in the eligible deposits report without delay and file an empty report when there is no data
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Hoiuste tagamise osafondi aruandluse kord (Rahandusministri 27.02.2016 määrus nr 14, RT I, 01.03.2016, 10), § 5 lg 4 ja 5, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 20, in force from 01.10.2026

titles.en: Remedy deficiencies in the eligible deposits report without delay and file an empty report when there is no data

summaries.en: When Finantsinspektsioon reports a deficiency, the credit institution remedies it and submits a corrected report without delay, and it does the same when it finds an error in data it filed earlier. Where it has no data within the report's scope it files the report empty.

instruments.title: Add Tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamine, the Minister of Finance's regulation on valuing residential property collateral (Rahandusministri 15.06.2016 määrus nr 25)

titles.et: Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele
titles.en: Requirements for valuing property that secures a consumer credit agreement relating to residential property

payload.officialRef: Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele (RT I, 17.06.2016, 8)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value residential collateral in line with good valuation practice on current, reliable data
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele (Rahandusministri 15.06.2016 määrus nr 25, RT I, 17.06.2016, 8), § 1 lg 1 ja 2 ja § 3¹ lg 1 ja 5, consolidated text RT I, 12.03.2026, 3, in force from 01.04.2026

titles.en: Value residential collateral in line with good valuation practice on current, reliable data

summaries.en: When offering a consumer credit agreement relating to residential property, a creditor, which here includes a credit institution, has the property or comparable collateral valued in line with good valuation practice and on current and reliable data, gathering all data needed and analysing every factor that affects its value.

obligations.title: Add the duty: If lending before 1 April 2026, bring valuation practice and documents into line with the new wording by 1 January 2027
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele (Rahandusministri 15.06.2016 määrus nr 25, RT I, 17.06.2016, 8), § 5 lg 2, consolidated text RT I, 12.03.2026, 3, in force from 01.04.2026

titles.en: If lending before 1 April 2026, bring valuation practice and documents into line with the new wording by 1 January 2027

summaries.en: A creditor or credit intermediary established and operating before 1 April 2026, or one that applied for its licence before that day, must bring its activity and documents into line with the wording of the regulation in force since 1 April 2026 by 1 January 2027 at the latest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Skip an inspection or use a statistical model only where the regulation and internal rules allow it
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele (Rahandusministri 15.06.2016 määrus nr 25, RT I, 17.06.2016, 8), § 3¹ lg 2, 3 ja 8, consolidated text RT I, 12.03.2026, 3, in force from 01.04.2026

titles.en: Skip an inspection or use a statistical model only where the regulation and internal rules allow it

summaries.en: The property may be valued without inspection only where the lender's internal rules set the conditions and skipping it is justified in the case, and the valuation report then explains why. An automated statistical model may be used only for refinancing, revaluation or amending the agreement, and only if it reflects the property's type, condition and location in enough detail, is current, accurate and regularly checked, and relies as far as possible on comparable market transactions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set internal competence requirements for valuers and use only qualified external valuers
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele (Rahandusministri 15.06.2016 määrus nr 25, RT I, 17.06.2016, 8), § 3¹ lg 4–7, consolidated text RT I, 12.03.2026, 3, in force from 01.04.2026

titles.en: Set internal competence requirements for valuers and use only qualified external valuers

summaries.en: The lender sets in internal rules the knowledge, skills and experience its staff need to value property and document the results, and anyone using a statistical model needs enough knowledge of and experience with it. Where an external valuer does the work, the valuer holds a valid real estate valuer qualification under the Professions Act and the report is approved by a holder of a level 6 real estate valuer or level 7 property valuer qualification.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document every valuation in a report with the content the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded elamukinnisvaraga seotud tarbijakrediidilepingu tagatiseks oleva kinnisvara hindamisele (Rahandusministri 15.06.2016 määrus nr 25, RT I, 17.06.2016, 8), § 4 lg 1–4, consolidated text RT I, 12.03.2026, 3, in force from 01.04.2026

titles.en: Document every valuation in a report with the content the regulation lists

summaries.en: Each valuation is documented in line with good valuation practice in a report that contains at least the items listed, among them its purpose, the property and rights attached to it, the market analysis, the method and calculation, the market value, the dates and the approver's name and signature, and the reasons and risks where no inspection was made. A shorter follow-up report is allowed within a year for property under construction or renovation, and a simplified report in the justified cases the lender's internal rules name, each with the minimum content set for it.

instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded krediidiandja või -vahendaja juhtide ja töötajate erialastele teadmistele, oskustele ning kogemustele (Rahandusministri 18.11.2016 määrus nr 52), RT I, 22.11.2016, 23, original text RT I, 22.11.2016, 23, in force from 25.11.2016, issued by the Minister of Finance under Krediidiandjate ja -vahendajate seadus § 40 lg 5, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Nõuded krediidiandja või -vahendaja juhtide ja töötajate erialastele teadmistele, oskustele ning kogemustele
titles.en: Requirements for the professional knowledge, skills and experience of the managers and employees of creditors and credit intermediaries

payload.officialRef: Nõuded krediidiandja või -vahendaja juhtide ja töötajate erialastele teadmistele, oskustele ning kogemustele (RT I, 22.11.2016, 23)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set knowledge, skills and experience requirements for each position and assess staff against them
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded krediidiandja või -vahendaja juhtide ja töötajate erialastele teadmistele, oskustele ning kogemustele (Rahandusministri 18.11.2016 määrus nr 52, RT I, 22.11.2016, 23), § 1 lg 1 ja § 2 lg 1–4, original text RT I, 22.11.2016, 23, in force from 25.11.2016

titles.en: Set knowledge, skills and experience requirements for each position and assess staff against them

summaries.en: A creditor or credit intermediary sets requirements for its managers' and employees' knowledge, skills and experience, decides for each position which of them are needed and at what level, describes them in internal rules and makes sure staff know and meet them. The level is set and assessed by at least the qualification the tasks need, shown by education, relevant training or a competence test and, where needed, earlier experience in lending, credit intermediation or advice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make sure staff know the general rules and can explain credit products, their cost and creditworthiness
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded krediidiandja või -vahendaja juhtide ja töötajate erialastele teadmistele, oskustele ning kogemustele (Rahandusministri 18.11.2016 määrus nr 52, RT I, 22.11.2016, 23), § 3 ja § 4 lg 1 ja 2, original text RT I, 22.11.2016, 23, in force from 25.11.2016

titles.en: Make sure staff know the general rules and can explain credit products, their cost and creditworthiness

summaries.en: Staff know the general principles and guidance of the business, consumer dispute resolution, data protection and anti-money laundering rules, and good practice and ethics in lending, and have financial and economic knowledge. Staff dealing with credit can explain the main terms of the credit offered, the consumer's rights, responsible lending, the solutions for payment difficulties and the interest and annual percentage rate calculation, and can assess a consumer's creditworthiness and explain collateral and its risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make sure staff offering mortgage credit or advice have the additional competences
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded krediidiandja või -vahendaja juhtide ja töötajate erialastele teadmistele, oskustele ning kogemustele (Rahandusministri 18.11.2016 määrus nr 52, RT I, 22.11.2016, 23), § 4 lg 3 ja 4, original text RT I, 22.11.2016, 23, in force from 25.11.2016

titles.en: Make sure staff offering mortgage credit or advice have the additional competences

summaries.en: Staff offering credit relating to residential property also know the general terms of real estate transactions, the land register and the rules for valuing collateral, and can apply the legal and internal requirements for valuing such collateral. Staff giving advisory services can explain how suitability is assessed, analyse the client's interests and needs against the agreements available and explain the costs of advice.

instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Tarbijakrediidi kulukuse määra arvutamise kord (Rahandusministri 13.10.2010 määrus nr 51), RT I 2010, 76, 584, consolidated text RT I, 20.07.2021, 6, in force from 23.07.2021, issued by the Minister of Finance under Võlaõigusseadus § 406 lg 6, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 5 of the regulation

titles.en: Procedure for calculating the annual percentage rate of charge of consumer credit

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate the annual percentage rate of charge with the annex's base equation, assuming the contract runs as agreed
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Tarbijakrediidi kulukuse määra arvutamise kord (Rahandusministri 13.10.2010 määrus nr 51, RT I 2010, 76, 584), § 2 ja § 3 lg 1 ja 2, consolidated text RT I, 20.07.2021, 6, in force from 23.07.2021

titles.en: Calculate the annual percentage rate of charge with the annex's base equation, assuming the contract runs as agreed

summaries.en: A consumer creditor calculates the annual percentage rate of charge with the base equation or the simplified formula in the annex, which equates the credit drawn with the present value of repayments and charges. The calculation assumes that the credit agreement stays in force for the agreed term and that both parties perform on the agreed terms and dates, and the credit starts on the date the first amount is drawn.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Express time periods as the regulation sets and state the rate to at least one decimal place
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Tarbijakrediidi kulukuse määra arvutamise kord (Rahandusministri 13.10.2010 määrus nr 51, RT I 2010, 76, 584), § 3 lg 3, 3¹ ja 4 ja § 3¹, consolidated text RT I, 20.07.2021, 6, in force from 23.07.2021

titles.en: Express time periods as the regulation sets and state the rate to at least one decimal place

summaries.en: Time periods are expressed in years or fractions of a year, a year having 365 days (366 in a leap year), 52 weeks or twelve equal months of 365/12 days, and periods that are not whole weeks, months or years are counted by the rules the regulation sets, which apply to agreements concluded from 1 January 2022. The result is stated as a percentage rounded to at least one decimal place.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File FATCA, CRS and DAC2 declarations in XML through the Tax and Customs Board's e-service
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksualase teabevahetuse deklaratsioonid (Rahandusministri 19.05.2015 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.05.2015, 4), § 1 p 1–14, § 2 lg 1 ja § 3, consolidated text RT I, 18.09.2026, 10, in force from 21.09.2026

titles.en: File FATCA, CRS and DAC2 declarations in XML through the Tax and Customs Board's e-service

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution files its declarations on information collected under the FATCA agreement with the United States, under Article 6 of the Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (CRS) and for exchange with EU member states (DAC2) on the XSD forms and code lists the regulation's annexes set. It submits them electronically in XML through the e-service of the Tax and Customs Board.

obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksualase teabevahetuse deklaratsioonid (Rahandusministri 19.05.2015 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.05.2015, 4), § 2 lg 2, consolidated text RT I, 18.09.2026, 10, in force from 21.09.2026

titles.en: Notify the Tax and Customs Board electronically when there is nothing to declare

summaries.en: Where there is no information to declare, the filer notifies the Tax and Customs Board of that electronically through its e-service.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a crypto-asset service provider, file CARF and DAC8 declarations in XML through the e-service
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Maksualase teabevahetuse deklaratsioonid (Rahandusministri 19.05.2015 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.05.2015, 4), § 1 p 17–22 ja § 2 lg 1, consolidated text RT I, 18.09.2026, 10, in force from 21.09.2026

titles.en: As a crypto-asset service provider, file CARF and DAC8 declarations in XML through the e-service

summaries.en: A reporting crypto-asset service provider files its declarations on crypto-asset information collected under Article 6 of the Convention (CARF) and for exchange with EU member states (DAC8) on the XSD forms and code lists of annexes 17 to 22, electronically in XML through the Tax and Customs Board's e-service.

instruments.title: Add Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest, the Minister of Finance's regulation on covered bond portfolio stress tests (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4), RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, original text RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, in force from 13.02.2023, issued by the Minister of Finance under Pandikirjaseadus § 22 lg 3, in line with § 56 lg 6 p 3, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Pandikirjaportfelli stressitesti tegemise korra, metoodika ja eesmärgi ning stressitesti käigus leitud puudujäägi katteks varade tagamise täpsemad nõuded
titles.en: Detailed requirements for the procedure, methodology and purpose of covered bond portfolio stress tests and for securing assets to cover a shortfall found in a stress test

payload.officialRef: Pandikirjaportfelli stressitesti tegemise korra, metoodika ja eesmärgi ning stressitesti käigus leitud puudujäägi katteks varade tagamise täpsemad nõuded (RT I, 10.02.2023, 35)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stress test each risk factor of the covered bond portfolio separately and together, and justify any left out
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4, RT I, 10.02.2023, 35), § 2 lg 2–5, original text RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, in force from 13.02.2023

titles.en: Stress test each risk factor of the covered bond portfolio separately and together, and justify any left out

summaries.en: A covered bond issuer stress tests credit and counterparty risk, the fall in property and other collateral prices including fire-sale values, interest rate risk, exchange rate risk and other factors its portfolio carries, each separately and at least once in combination with correlations fitting a stress situation. It assesses whether the cover pool's value suffices both without and with the limits of § 25 lg 4¹ and § 26 lg 1 of the Covered Bonds Act, and explains to Finantsinspektsioon why any factor it leaves out is not relevant.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run scenario stress tests at least quarterly and sensitivity analyses at least yearly, and more often when markets change
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4, RT I, 10.02.2023, 35), § 2 lg 6 ja 7, original text RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, in force from 13.02.2023

titles.en: Run scenario stress tests at least quarterly and sensitivity analyses at least yearly, and more often when markets change

summaries.en: Scenario stress tests are run at least once a quarter and the sensitivity analysis at least once a year. When market conditions change materially the issuer tests more often and, where needed, runs extraordinary tests, and its stress test procedure provides for reporting the results to Finantsinspektsioon.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Build the stress test procedure and programme as the regulation sets, starting from the EBA's latest adverse scenario
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4, RT I, 10.02.2023, 35), § 3 lg 1–8 ja § 4, original text RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, in force from 13.02.2023

titles.en: Build the stress test procedure and programme as the regulation sets, starting from the EBA's latest adverse scenario

summaries.en: The issuer bases its stress test procedure on Finantsinspektsioon's relevant guide and the EBA's guidelines, provides for scenario analysis, an annual sensitivity analysis, its risk appetite and hedges, historical and hypothetical data and the regions where its exposures concentrate, and changes it when Finantsinspektsioon finds further risks must be covered. Its programme contains at least the elements the regulation lists, including clear responsibilities, data infrastructure, methodology, key assumptions and planned measures, a static balance sheet and an approval and review process, and its forward-looking scenarios start from the EBA's latest adverse stress test scenario.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run the prescribed sensitivity analyses and give the results to Finantsinspektsioon within three months of the year end
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4, RT I, 10.02.2023, 35), § 5, original text RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, in force from 13.02.2023

titles.en: Run the prescribed sensitivity analyses and give the results to Finantsinspektsioon within three months of the year end

summaries.en: The issuer runs at least the sensitivity analyses the regulation lists: property values falling by 10, 25 and 40 per cent, defaulted and deferred claims making up 10 per cent of the collateral-related claims, general government net positions of 10 and 20 per cent of GDP where the pool holds such claims, the central banks' main refinancing rates changing globally by up to 2 per cent, and exchange rates changing by up to 10 per cent for EEA states and Switzerland, up to 20 per cent for other OECD states and at least 25 per cent for all others. It submits the results to Finantsinspektsioon within three months of the end of its financial year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act on the results and cover any shortfall the stress tests reveal
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjaportfelli stressitest (Rahandusministri 27.01.2023 määrus nr 4, RT I, 10.02.2023, 35), § 6 lg 1–4, original text RT I, 10.02.2023, 35, in force from 13.02.2023

titles.en: Act on the results and cover any shortfall the stress tests reveal

summaries.en: The issuer's management board regularly assesses the stress test procedure and results, which are always taken into account in business plans and market strategies, and the shortfall is measured by the largest one found in the tests. Where the value of the cover pool would fall short of § 18 lg 1, 2 and 2¹ of the Covered Bonds Act without the statutory limits, the issuer increases or replaces the registered cover assets; where it would fall short with the limits, it keeps unencumbered assets of that amount ready to be entered in the cover register.

obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjadega seonduvate järelevalvearuannete sisu, nende koostamise alused ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 30.08.2019 määrus nr 40, RT I, 03.09.2019, 2), § 2, § 8 ja § 11 lg 2, consolidated text RT I, 09.06.2023, 12, in force from 01.01.2024

titles.en: Submit the five covered bond supervisory reports to Finantsinspektsioon

summaries.en: A credit institution licensed to issue covered bonds draws up and submits to Finantsinspektsioon the cover pool report (code 218), the liquidity report (code 878), the covered liabilities report (code 219), the covered bond portfolio stress test report (code 220) and the stress test scenario report (code 224) on the annexed forms. Amounts are in euros to two decimals and the overcollateralisation ratio a decimal rounded to four places, and the wording in force since 1 January 2024 applies to periods ending on or after 31 March 2024.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the covered bond reports in XML under Finantsinspektsioon's technical requirements and file empty ones when there is no data
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Pandikirjadega seonduvate järelevalvearuannete sisu, nende koostamise alused ja esitamise kord (Rahandusministri 30.08.2019 määrus nr 40, RT I, 03.09.2019, 2), § 9, consolidated text RT I, 09.06.2023, 12, in force from 01.01.2024

titles.en: Submit the covered bond reports in XML under Finantsinspektsioon's technical requirements and file empty ones when there is no data

summaries.en: The reports go to Finantsinspektsioon electronically as XML, following the technical requirements on Finantsinspektsioon's website. Where there is no data within a report's scope the issuer files it empty.

titles.et: Täpsemad nõuded eurofondi riskide juhtimisele, eurofondi osakute või aktsiate väljalaskmise avalduse ja tagasivõtmise avalduste ning eurofondi varaga tehtud tehingute registreerimisele ja salvestamisele, tehingute salvestamiseks mõeldud elektroonilisele andmetöötlussüsteemile, tehingutest aruandmisele ning eurofondi investeerimisotsuste täitmisele
titles.en: Detailed requirements for UCITS risk management, for recording subscription and redemption orders and transactions in UCITS assets, for the electronic recording system, for reporting on transactions and for executing UCITS investment decisions

payload.shortName: Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine
payload.officialRef: Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13 (RT I, 02.02.2017, 5)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate each UCITS's global exposure from derivatives at least once a day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 1 lg 2 ja § 2 lg 1–5, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Calculate each UCITS's global exposure from derivatives at least once a day

summaries.en: A management company managing a UCITS calculates the fund's global exposure from derivatives at least daily, by the commitment approach, a value-at-risk method or another adequately sophisticated method chosen in view of the investment policy and the derivatives used. The exposure may not exceed the fund's net asset value, and repurchase agreements and securities lending that affect it are taken into account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure counterparty risk from OTC derivatives within the fund's derivative limits
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 4 lg 1–7, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Measure counterparty risk from OTC derivatives within the fund's derivative limits

summaries.en: Counterparty risk from a UCITS's over-the-counter derivatives is subject to the fund's derivative investment limits and measured on the positive mark-to-market value of each contract. Positions may be netted only with the same counterparty and only where the netting agreement is enforceable, collateral received must be liquid, and collateral given to a counterparty is taken into account in measuring the risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value OTC derivatives fairly and independently under a documented procedure
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 5 lg 1–5, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Value OTC derivatives fairly and independently under a documented procedure

summaries.en: The management company checks that the value of each OTC derivative exposure is fair, meets the fund's investment criteria and does not rest only on the counterparty's quotes, and sets a documented valuation procedure for it based on adequate, accurate and independent valuation. It sets how far the risk management function carries these tasks, and where it delegates valuation it meets the conditions for delegation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report to Finantsinspektsioon once a year on each UCITS's use of derivatives
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 6, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Report to Finantsinspektsioon once a year on each UCITS's use of derivatives

summaries.en: Once a year the management company submits to Finantsinspektsioon, for each UCITS it manages and for the calendar year, a report on the types of derivatives used, the risks attached, the quantitative limits for assessing those risks and the techniques chosen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record every UCITS transaction and every subscription and redemption order with the data the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 7 ja § 8, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Record every UCITS transaction and every subscription and redemption order with the data the regulation lists

summaries.en: For every order or transaction for a UCITS's account the management company records in its data processing system the fund, the person acting, the security, volume, type, price, the dates and times, the person who placed it, the reasons for any withdrawal and the counterparty and execution venue. For every subscription or redemption order it records the fund, who placed and received it, when, the payment terms, type, execution date, the number of units, the price, the total value and the total cost including fees.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep UCITS records reconstructable, tamper-proof and available to Finantsinspektsioon for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 9, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Keep UCITS records reconstructable, tamper-proof and available to Finantsinspektsioon for five years

summaries.en: The recorded data must let every material step of each transaction be reconstructed, show every correction with the content before it, be impossible to manipulate and be available to Finantsinspektsioon. The data are kept for five years in a secure system that protects their integrity and confidentiality.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Confirm each executed subscription or redemption to the investor by the first working day after execution
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 10 lg 1–6, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Confirm each executed subscription or redemption to the investor by the first working day after execution

summaries.en: The management company sends the unitholder or shareholder a confirmation with the data the regulation lists without delay and at the latest on the first working day after executing the order, or after receiving a third party's confirmation of it. No confirmation is needed where a third party must promptly send one with the same content, regular orders may be confirmed every six months in a summary, and the investor may ask about an order's status at any time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Execute and transmit UCITS orders for the best result, review the rules each year and allocate aggregated orders fairly
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Eurofondi riskide juhtimine ja tehingute registreerimine (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 13, RT I, 02.02.2017, 5), § 11–13, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 5, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Execute and transmit UCITS orders for the best result, review the rules each year and allocate aggregated orders fairly

summaries.en: The management company weighs price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size and nature in executing or transmitting orders for a UCITS, in the light of the fund's policy, objectives and risks, and reviews its execution and transmission rules at least yearly and on any material change. Executed orders are recorded and allocated promptly and comparable ones executed in turn; where an aggregated order is partly filled the fund is allocated before the company's own account, unless the company can show the order could not otherwise have been executed on such terms.

instruments.title: Add Fondi vara puhasväärtuse määramine, the Minister of Finance's regulation on determining a fund's net asset value (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 11)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi vara puhasväärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 11), RT I, 02.02.2017, 3, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 3, in force from 05.02.2017, issued by the Minister of Finance under Investeerimisfondide seadus § 54 lg 11, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja
