titles.en: Procedure for determining the net asset value of an investment fund

payload.officialRef: Investeerimisfondi vara puhasväärtuse määramise kord (RT I, 02.02.2017, 3)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate a fund's net asset value as its assets less the claims the regulation lists
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi vara puhasväärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 11, RT I, 02.02.2017, 3), § 1 ja § 3, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 3, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Calculate a fund's net asset value as its assets less the claims the regulation lists

summaries.en: The management company of a public contractual fund or a fund set up as a public limited company determines the fund's net asset value by deducting from the value of its assets the claims against it from management and other fees including performance fees, custody fees not borne by the company, distributions and redemptions owed to investors, transactions and their charges, borrowing and its costs, accrued interest and other liabilities and any other claims.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt and publish a net asset value procedure with the content the regulation sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi vara puhasväärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 11, RT I, 02.02.2017, 3), § 4 lg 1–5, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 3, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Adopt and publish a net asset value procedure with the content the regulation sets

summaries.en: The management company adopts a procedure for determining the net asset value that sets the valuation principles and methods for every asset class the investment policy allows, with the choice of regulated markets, the criteria for listed and unlisted securities, the treatment of distributions and the procedure for correcting errors and compensating losses, paying particular attention to assets hard to value. It publishes the procedure on its website, and the procedure and its changes take effect no earlier than a month after investors are told or it is published.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Adopt internal valuation control rules and tell Finantsinspektsioon at once of the procedure, the rules and their changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi vara puhasväärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 11, RT I, 02.02.2017, 3), § 4 lg 6 ja 7, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 3, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Adopt internal valuation control rules and tell Finantsinspektsioon at once of the procedure, the rules and their changes

summaries.en: Beside the procedure the management company adopts internal rules for checking the reliability of the fund's asset values, setting the methods and components used, how often values are checked and why, and how a check delegated to a third party is controlled. It informs Finantsinspektsioon without delay when it adopts or changes the procedure or the control rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value fund assets transparently and consistently, at market value where there is one, and document any departure
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisfondi vara puhasväärtuse määramise kord (Rahandusministri 31.01.2017 määrus nr 11, RT I, 02.02.2017, 3), § 5 lg 1–7, original text RT I, 02.02.2017, 3, in force from 05.02.2017

titles.en: Value fund assets transparently and consistently, at market value where there is one, and document any departure

summaries.en: Valuation principles and methods must be transparent, applied consistently and on the same basis to all assets of a fund whatever its unit classes, take account of the investors' interests and the fund's type, policy and redemption terms, and value assets at market value first and otherwise at fair value under the procedure. The company justifies its choices in writing when Finantsinspektsioon asks, and where it exceptionally departs from the procedure, as the procedure allows, it records in writing why and how it reached the value.

instruments.title: Add Investeerimisühingu aruanded, the Minister of Finance's regulation on investment firms' reports to Finantsinspektsioon (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisühingu aruanded (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40), RTL 2008, 97, 1348, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 11, in force from 07.09.2026, issued by the Minister of Finance under Väärtpaberituru seadus § 108 lg 3 ja 4, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in § 21 of the regulation

titles.et: Investeerimisühingu, investeerimisühingu emaettevõtja ja välisriigi investeerimisühingu filiaali aruannete sisu, koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord
titles.en: Content, methodology and submission of the reports of investment firms, their parent undertakings and branches of foreign investment firms

payload.officialRef: Investeerimisühingu, investeerimisühingu emaettevõtja ja välisriigi investeerimisühingu filiaali aruannete sisu, koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord (RTL 2008, 97, 1348)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the solo supervisory reports to Finantsinspektsioon monthly or quarterly
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisühingu aruanded (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40, RTL 2008, 97, 1348), § 2, § 10 ja § 12 lg 1–4 ja 6, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 11, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Submit the solo supervisory reports to Finantsinspektsioon monthly or quarterly

summaries.en: Every investment firm operating in Estonia, and each branch of a foreign investment firm, draws up its balance sheet, income statement, claims and liabilities, securities, derivatives (not for branches), investment services and supplementary income statement reports on the annexed forms. A firm licensed for dealing on own account or underwriting with a firm commitment reports the first five monthly and the other two quarterly, any other firm all seven quarterly; the investment services and supplementary income reports are due within 20 days after the quarter and the others as § 109 lg 1 of the Securities Market Act sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a parent of an investment firm group, submit the consolidated reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisühingu aruanded (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40, RTL 2008, 97, 1348), § 11 lg 1–3 ja § 12 lg 5, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 11, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: As a parent of an investment firm group, submit the consolidated reports

summaries.en: The parent undertaking of an investment firm consolidation group draws up the consolidated balance sheet, income statement and securities reports (codes 43, 44 and 458) and submits them as § 109 lg 2 of the Securities Market Act sets, unless it reports under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare the reports in Estonian and euros, submit them in XML and correct deficiencies
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisühingu aruanded (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40, RTL 2008, 97, 1348), § 13, § 16, § 17 lg 3 ja § 18, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 11, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Prepare the reports in Estonian and euros, submit them in XML and correct deficiencies

summaries.en: The reports are drawn up in Estonian and in euros, in whole units, as at the period end or cumulatively from the start of the year as the regulation sets, and go to Finantsinspektsioon as XML following its technical requirements, with an empty report where there is no data. When Finantsinspektsioon notifies a deficiency, or the firm finds an error in earlier data, the firm submits a corrected report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare the balance sheet and income statement under IFRS following Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisühingu aruanded (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40, RTL 2008, 97, 1348), § 14 lg 1 ja 2 ja § 15, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 11, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Prepare the balance sheet and income statement under IFRS following Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451

summaries.en: The solo and consolidated balance sheet and income statement are recognised and measured under the IFRS adopted in the EU, following the references to IFRS in Annex III and the instructions in Annex V of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451 and the regulation's own balance sheet and income statement templates. Currency, country, date and ISIN codes follow ISO 4217, ISO 3166-2, ISO 8601-1 and ISO 6166.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the EU supervisory reports under the technical rules of Eesti Pank's transmission regulation
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Investeerimisühingu aruanded (Rahandusministri 28.11.2008 määrus nr 40, RTL 2008, 97, 1348), § 19¹, consolidated text RT I, 04.09.2026, 11, in force from 07.09.2026

titles.en: Send the EU supervisory reports under the technical rules of Eesti Pank's transmission regulation

summaries.en: When an investment firm submits supervisory reports under Implementing Regulations (EU) 2021/451, 2021/453, 2021/763 and 2021/2284, it follows the technical requirements of Eesti Pank's regulation nr 11 of 2 July 2014 on the form for transmitting supervisory reports under the Capital Requirements Regulation.

titles.et: Makseasutuste omavahendite aruandluse kord, omavahendite minimaalsuuruse arvutamise põhimõtted ning aruannete skeemid, aruannete koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord

payload.officialRef: Makseasutuste omavahendite aruandluse kord, omavahendite minimaalsuuruse arvutamise põhimõtted ning aruannete skeemid, aruannete koostamise metoodika ja esitamise kord (RT I 2010, 81, 613)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate own funds under the act's rules, at balance sheet value and within its limits
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 21.10.2010 määrus nr 54, RT I 2010, 81, 613), § 2 ja § 6, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 2, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Calculate own funds under the act's rules, at balance sheet value and within its limits

summaries.en: A payment institution licensed in Estonia calculates its own funds under §§ 65 and 72 to 76 of the Payment Institutions and E-money Institutions Act, takes their components at balance sheet value unless the act or the regulation says otherwise, and applies the limits of § 65 lg 3¹, 4 and 6 of the act when calculating own funds under § 72 lg 2.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the payment institution reports for the services it provides within 20 days after each period
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 21.10.2010 määrus nr 54, RT I 2010, 81, 613), § 12 lg 1, 1², 1³, 2³–2⁶ ja 3, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 2, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Submit the payment institution reports for the services it provides within 20 days after each period

summaries.en: A payment institution providing the services in points 1 to 6 of § 3 lg 1 of the act without an exemption reports its payment transactions, clients' assets, own funds, balance sheet and income statement quarterly; one providing the service in point 7 reports its payment transactions, own funds, balance sheet and income statement quarterly and a professional liability insurance report yearly, and one providing the service in point 8 reports its balance sheet and income statement half-yearly and the insurance report yearly. Each report is due within 20 days after its period, or after the financial year for the yearly one, using the report codes the regulation sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As an exempt payment institution, report clients' assets, balance sheet, income and payment transactions every half year
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 21.10.2010 määrus nr 54, RT I 2010, 81, 613), § 12 lg 2 ja 2², consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 2, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: As an exempt payment institution, report clients' assets, balance sheet, income and payment transactions every half year

summaries.en: A payment institution operating under the exemption of § 11 lg 1 or 2 of the act reports its clients' assets, balance sheet, income statement and the exempt institution's payment transactions report every half year, within 20 days after the period ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare the reports in euros on the set basis and submit them in XML under Finantsinspektsioon's requirements
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Makseasutuste omavahendid ja aruanded (Rahandusministri 21.10.2010 määrus nr 54, RT I 2010, 81, 613), § 13 ja § 14, consolidated text RT I, 13.01.2023, 2, in force from 16.01.2023

titles.en: Prepare the reports in euros on the set basis and submit them in XML under Finantsinspektsioon's requirements

summaries.en: The reports are in euros and whole units, with foreign currency converted at the ECB rate of the period's last working day, own funds as at the period end and minimum own funds as at the previous year end, and the balance sheet and income statement follow Estonian good accounting practice or IFRS with the regulation's specific rules. They go to Finantsinspektsioon as XML under its technical requirements, with an empty report where there is no data.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the prospectus the general information on the fund and the description of its units
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded prospektile ja välisriigi fondi kohta esitatavale lisateabele (Rahandusministri 18.02.2017 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.02.2017, 24), § 1 lg 2–4, § 2 ja § 3, original text RT I, 22.02.2017, 24, in force from 25.02.2017

titles.en: Give the prospectus the general information on the fund and the description of its units

summaries.en: The prospectus of every public fund formed under the Investment Funds Act and offered in Estonia, pension funds and sub-funds included, gives the general information the regulation lists, among them the fund's name, type, formation date, tax treatment, auditor, any trading venue, the net asset value calculation and publication, report deadlines, supervisor and the date of the data. It describes each class of units, including how ownership is evidenced, issue, redemption and switching terms, any suspension, minimum holdings, distributions, general meetings and liquidation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Describe the fund's investment objectives, typical investor and investment policy, keeping objectives and policy apart
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded prospektile ja välisriigi fondi kohta esitatavale lisateabele (Rahandusministri 18.02.2017 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.02.2017, 24), § 4 ja § 5, original text RT I, 22.02.2017, 24, in force from 25.02.2017

titles.en: Describe the fund's investment objectives, typical investor and investment policy, keeping objectives and policy apart

summaries.en: The prospectus describes the investment objectives, any index followed or guaranteed return, and the typical investor with the expected experience, risk tolerance and investment horizon. It sets out the investment policy, limits and diversification rules, the sectors and issuers targeted, techniques, active or passive management, issuers above 35 per cent of the fund, the purpose and effect of derivatives and any securities financing transactions, clearly distinguished from the objectives.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show past performance as Regulation (EU) No 583/2010 sets and describe all material risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded prospektile ja välisriigi fondi kohta esitatavale lisateabele (Rahandusministri 18.02.2017 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.02.2017, 24), § 6 ja § 7, original text RT I, 22.02.2017, 24, in force from 25.02.2017

titles.en: Show past performance as Regulation (EU) No 583/2010 sets and describe all material risks

summaries.en: The prospectus presents past performance as Commission Regulation (EU) No 583/2010 sets and states the fund's risk level, giving a short and clear account of the possible and material risks, among them market, credit, settlement, liquidity, currency, custody and concentration risk and, where relevant, guarantor, inflation and legal risk. Where the net asset value may be highly volatile the prospectus draws attention to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose the management company, the depositary and any delegates, with their conflicts of interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded prospektile ja välisriigi fondi kohta esitatavale lisateabele (Rahandusministri 18.02.2017 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.02.2017, 24), § 8–10, original text RT I, 22.02.2017, 24, in force from 25.02.2017

titles.en: Disclose the management company, the depositary and any delegates, with their conflicts of interest

summaries.en: The prospectus names the management company with its registration, licence, other funds, board members, capital, rights and duties and the tasks it may delegate, and the depositary with its activities, liability, conflicts of interest and delegated safekeeping, confirming that updated conflict information is given on request. Where management tasks are delegated it names each delegate, the scope of delegation, the delegate's other main activities and supervisor.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose fees, costs and issue and redemption prices, and where the fund documents can be seen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded prospektile ja välisriigi fondi kohta esitatavale lisateabele (Rahandusministri 18.02.2017 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.02.2017, 24), § 11 ja § 12, original text RT I, 22.02.2017, 24, in force from 25.02.2017

titles.en: Disclose fees, costs and issue and redemption prices, and where the fund documents can be seen

summaries.en: The prospectus states the management and custody fees with their rates or caps and how they are calculated, any fee-sharing arrangements, the fee caps of target funds where over 30 per cent is invested in other funds, how issue and redemption prices are set and published, their fees, and that intermediaries may charge further fees. It says where the prospectus, fund rules, latest annual and half-yearly reports, the investment decision-maker and the manager's holding can be seen, and that copies are given free on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: For a fund established abroad, add the extra information the regulation lists to the prospectus
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Nõuded prospektile ja välisriigi fondi kohta esitatavale lisateabele (Rahandusministri 18.02.2017 määrus nr 16, RT I, 22.02.2017, 24), § 13, original text RT I, 22.02.2017, 24, in force from 25.02.2017

titles.en: For a fund established abroad, add the extra information the regulation lists to the prospectus

summaries.en: Where the fund is established in a foreign state, its prospectus also states any fixed term of the management company and of the management contract, whether units are registered or bearer units, the acquisition, switching and redemption terms and fees of any sub-funds, the other states where the units are marketed and the main websites where information on the fund, its issue and redemption fees included, is published.

instruments.title: Add Valitsuse sanktsioon julgeoleku kaitseks, the Government's financial sanction against those who support Russia's attack on Ukraine (Vabariigi Valitsuse 13.03.2025 määrus nr 18)
instruments.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas (Vabariigi Valitsuse 13.03.2025 määrus nr 18), RT I, 14.03.2025, 31, original text RT I, 14.03.2025, 31, in force from 15.03.2025, issued by the Government of the Republic under Rahvusvahelise sanktsiooni seadus § 27 lg 1, read through the gazette's own interface; entry into force read in the text's header in Riigi Teataja

titles.et: Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas
titles.en: Government sanction to protect Estonia's security and interests and against the Russian Federation's actions in Ukraine

payload.officialRef: Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas (RT I, 14.03.2025, 31)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze the funds and economic resources in Estonia of the persons the Minister of Foreign Affairs designates
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas (Vabariigi Valitsuse 13.03.2025 määrus nr 18, RT I, 14.03.2025, 31), § 2 lg 1 p 1, lg 3 ja 4, original text RT I, 14.03.2025, 31, in force from 15.03.2025

titles.en: Freeze the funds and economic resources in Estonia of the persons the Minister of Foreign Affairs designates

summaries.en: All funds and economic resources located in Estonia that belong to, are held by or are controlled by the natural or legal persons, entities or bodies designated by directive of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, or by persons connected with them, must be frozen. Freezing means preventing any movement, transfer, change, use of or access to the funds, and any use of economic resources to obtain funds, goods or services, and the international sanctions act's rules on financial sanctions apply.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make no funds or economic resources available, directly or indirectly, to the designated persons
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas (Vabariigi Valitsuse 13.03.2025 määrus nr 18, RT I, 14.03.2025, 31), § 2 lg 1 p 2 ja § 3 lg 1–5, original text RT I, 14.03.2025, 31, in force from 15.03.2025

titles.en: Make no funds or economic resources available, directly or indirectly, to the designated persons

summaries.en: No funds or economic resources may be made available, directly or indirectly, to the persons designated by directive of the Minister of Foreign Affairs or to persons connected with them. Only the competent authority may permit the release of frozen funds or making funds available, in the cases and on the conditions the regulation lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit incoming transfers to frozen accounts only as frozen amounts and notify the competent authority at once
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas (Vabariigi Valitsuse 13.03.2025 määrus nr 18, RT I, 14.03.2025, 31), § 3 lg 6 ja 7, original text RT I, 14.03.2025, 31, in force from 15.03.2025

titles.en: Credit incoming transfers to frozen accounts only as frozen amounts and notify the competent authority at once

summaries.en: A financial or credit institution may credit frozen accounts with funds a third party transfers to a designated person's account, as long as every amount added is also frozen, and it notifies the competent authority of such transfers without delay. Interest and other earnings on frozen accounts and payments due under earlier contracts or decisions may be added on the same condition.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take no part in activities that circumvent the sanction
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon Eesti julgeoleku ja huvide kaitseks ning Venemaa Föderatsiooni tegevuse vastu Ukrainas (Vabariigi Valitsuse 13.03.2025 määrus nr 18, RT I, 14.03.2025, 31), § 2 lg 5, original text RT I, 14.03.2025, 31, in force from 15.03.2025

titles.en: Take no part in activities that circumvent the sanction

summaries.en: It is prohibited to take part knowingly and intentionally in activities whose object or effect is to circumvent the regulation's prohibitions, including taking part without seeking that object or effect while aware that it may follow and accepting that possibility.

instruments.title: Add Valitsuse sanktsioon relvajõudude toetamise vastu, the Government's sanction banning support for the armed forces of Russia and Belarus (Vabariigi Valitsuse 01.04.2024 määrus nr 18)

titles.et: Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon seoses jätkuva rünnakuga Ukraina suveräänsuse ja territoriaalse terviklikkuse vastu
titles.en: Government sanction in connection with the continuing attack on Ukraine's sovereignty and territorial integrity

payload.officialRef: Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon seoses jätkuva rünnakuga Ukraina suveräänsuse ja territoriaalse terviklikkuse vastu (RT I, 02.04.2024, 14)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not finance or otherwise support the armed forces or armed units of Russia or Belarus
obligations.sourceLabel: Riigi Teataja, Vabariigi Valitsuse sanktsioon seoses jätkuva rünnakuga Ukraina suveräänsuse ja territoriaalse terviklikkuse vastu (Vabariigi Valitsuse 01.04.2024 määrus nr 18, RT I, 02.04.2024, 14), § 1 ja 2, consolidated text RT I, 25.03.2026, 18, in force from 26.03.2026

titles.en: Do not finance or otherwise support the armed forces or armed units of Russia or Belarus

summaries.en: Every natural and legal person in Estonia, and every Estonian citizen and legal person registered in Estonia abroad, is prohibited from joining the armed forces or armed units of the Russian Federation or the Republic of Belarus and from giving them military or non-military assistance, including financing them, or otherwise taking part in or supporting their activity. Since 26 March 2026 the regulation has no end date.
